name: appmixer.limecrm.core.UpdatedObject
label: Updated Object
description: Triggers when an object of the selected limetype is updated, optionally only when a property changes to a given value. Outputs the object and the previous values of the changed properties. In Webhook mode it needs Lime Webhooks on the Lime CRM server (included in Lime CRM Cloud) and an API user that is an administrator or a member of the Webhook Users group; Polling mode checks the API every minute instead.
author: Appmixer <info@appmixer.com>

limetype.label: Limetype
limetype.tooltip: Pick a limetype or type its API name, e.g. company, person or deal.

mode.label: Mode
mode.tooltip: How the trigger learns about changes. Webhook (default) gets them from Lime Webhooks right away; it needs Lime Webhooks on the server (included in Lime CRM Cloud, an optional package on-premise) and an API user that is an administrator or a member of the Webhook Users group. Polling asks the Lime CRM API for changes every minute and works without Lime Webhooks.

conditionProperty.label: Only When Property
conditionProperty.tooltip: Optional. The API name of a property, e.g. dealstatus. The trigger then fires only for updates that change this property to the value below; other updates are skipped.

conditionValue.label: Changes To
conditionValue.tooltip: The value the property must change to, e.g. closed. Option properties take the option key, relations the ID, yes/no properties true or false. Comparison is case-insensitive; leave empty to fire when the property is cleared. In Polling mode the first update of an object the trigger has not seen before fires when the property has this value, because its previous value is not known.
